facts.en: Completed a diploma in Logistics Administration at Fictional Institute D098 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D098 完成物流行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a warehouse scheduling clerk at Fictional Distribution Hub D098 from 2022-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2026-08 在虚构配送中心 D098 担任仓库排期文员。

facts.en: Updated dock-booking lists and shift handover sheets using schedules approved by the planning lead.
facts.zh: 使用计划负责人批准的日程更新月台预约清单及班次交接表。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters to flag overlapping arrivals and missing carrier references.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选标出到货重叠及缺失承运商编号。

facts.en: With a planner, introduced a revised arrival-status sheet in 2025-12.
facts.zh: 在 2025-12 与计划员合作引入修订到货状态表。

facts.en: Reported late-arrival counts of 36 among 200 bookings in 2025-12 and 18 among 120 bookings in 2026-02.
facts.zh: 报告 2025-12 的 200 个预约中有 36 个延迟到货，2026-02 的 120 个预约中有 18 个。

facts.en: The periods differed in seasonal volume, carrier mix and staffing; the comparison does not establish that the sheet caused fewer delays.
facts.zh: 两个期间的季节量、承运商构成及人员配置不同；该比较不证明状态表导致延误减少。

facts.en: No controlled analysis, throughput improvement or warehouse-wide productivity gain was measured.
facts.zh: 未测量受控分析、吞吐量改善或全仓生产率增益。

facts.en: During 2026-03, checked 72 booking records with the planner and corrected 11 missing carrier references from approved confirmations.
facts.zh: 在 2026-03 与计划员检查 72 条预约记录，并根据获批确认更正 11 个缺失承运商编号。

facts.en: Called carriers to confirm agreed slots and escalated requested changes for planner approval.
facts.zh: 致电承运商确认商定时段，并将请求变更上报计划员审批。

facts.en: Drafted a peak-season staffing worksheet in 2026-06 using fictional assumptions; it was not adopted as a workforce plan.
facts.zh: 2026-06 使用虚构假设起草旺季人员配置工作表；未被采纳为劳动力计划。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-08 capacity-planning course exercise with fictional arrival data, separate from operational scheduling decisions.
facts.zh: 2024-08 使用虚构到货数据完成产能计划课程练习，与运营排期决策分开。

facts.en: At the 2025-12 peak, tracked 10 dock schedules daily; the normal 2026-08 allocation was 6.
facts.zh: 在 2025-12 高峰期每天跟踪 10 份月台日程；2026-08 常规分工为 6 份。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Sports Equipment Library V098 on Saturdays from 2023-06 to 2023-11 while employed.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2023-11 任职期间，星期六在虚构运动器材资料馆 V098 志愿服务。

facts.en: For that library, labeled return shelves rather than planning a commercial warehouse.
facts.zh: 为该资料馆标记归还货架，而非规划商业仓库。

facts.en: Made a personal cardboard railway station model in 2020, unrelated to operational layout design.
facts.zh: 2020 年制作个人纸板火车站模型，与运营布局设计无关。

facts.en: Keeps a recreational cloud-sketch notebook.
facts.zh: 保留休闲云朵素描笔记。

facts.en: A draft appraisal says the sheet cut delays by 50%, comparing raw counts while ignoring the different booking denominators and seasons.
facts.zh: 一份考评草稿称状态表使延误减少 50%，仅比较原始计数，忽略不同预约分母及季节。

facts.en: Labeled booking counts and late counts separately in handover summaries instead of treating them as equivalent rates.
facts.zh: 在交接摘要中将预约计数及延迟计数分开标记，而非视为等价比率。

facts.en: No authority to approve overtime, redesign dock capacity or make independent safety decisions is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录批准加班、重新设计月台容量或独立作出安全决策的权限。
